company.shortDescription: Matterport digitizes spaces into accurate, immersive 3D digital twins with its all-in-one platform.
company.description: Matterport is a spatial data firm dedicated to digitizing and indexing the built environment. Its all-in-one 3D data platform allows anyone to transform a location into an exact and immersive digital twin that can be used to design, develop, operate, promote, and comprehend any environment.

aiResearchSummary.text: Matterport is researching systems for capturing and aligning three-dimensional scenes, as described in Capturing and aligning three-dimensional scenes, and methods for generating panoramic three-dimensional models, as in System and method of capturing and generating panoramic three-dimensional models. Their work includes processing and transmitting 3D data associated with 3D models of interior environments and integrating object detection and interactive 3D models. These areas reflect Matterport’s focus on immersive 3D digital twin technologies.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Equity round raised $295,000,000, or 70.51% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $373,000,000 to $373,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 24 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 43 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
